20096-welsh-folk-lore-a-collection-of-th.creator: Unknown
20096-welsh-folk-lore-a-collection-of-th.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The Fairy tales that abound in the Principality have much in common with like legends in other countries. This points to a common origin of all such tales. There is a real and unreal, a mythical and a material aspect to Fairy Folk-Lore. The prevalence, the obscurity, and the different versions of the same Fairy tale show that their origin dates from remote antiquity.

3312-the-native-son.title: The Native Son
3312-the-native-son.creator: Inez Haynes Irwin
3312-the-native-son.description: A book by Inez Haynes Irwin. Even as I was irritated, I now irritate. Even as I was bored, I now bore. Ever since I first saw California, and became, inevitably, a Californiac, I have been talking about it, irritating and boring uncounted thousands. I begin placatingly enough, "Yes, I know you aren't going to believe this," I say. "Once I didn't believe it myself.

762-british-airships-past-present-and-fu.title: British Airships: Past, Present and Future
762-british-airships-past-present-and-fu.creator: George Whale
762-british-airships-past-present-and-fu.description: A book by George Whale. The airship is, therefore, nothing else than a dirigible balloon, for the engines and other weights connected with the structure are supported in the air by an envelope or balloon, or a series of such chambers, according to design, filled with hydrogen or gas of some other nature.

arxiv-1811-08407.title: Direct observation of anapoles by neutron diffraction
arxiv-1811-08407.creator: S. W. Lovesey, T. Chatterji, A. Stunault, D. D. Khalyavin, G. van der Laan
arxiv-1811-08407.description: Abstract The scope of magnetic neutron scattering has been expanded by the observation of electronic Dirac dipoles (anapoles) that are polar (parity-odd) and magnetic (time-odd). A zero-magnetization ferromagnet Sm 0.976 Gd 0.024 Al 2 with a diamond-type structure presents Dirac multipoles at basis-forbidden reflections that include the standard (2, 2, 2) reflection.

arxiv-2106-03271.title: Fixing Vulnerabilities Potentially Hinders Maintainability
arxiv-2106-03271.creator: Sofia Reis, Rui Abreu, Luis Cruz
arxiv-2106-03271.description: Abstract Security is a requirement of utmost importance to produce high-quality software. However, there is still a considerable amount of vulnerabilities being discovered and fixed almost weekly. We hypothesize that developers affect the maintainability of their codebases when patching vulnerabilities. This paper evaluates the impact of patches to improve security on the maintainability of open-source software.

arxiv-2201-00348.title: Fundamental trade-off between the speed of light and the Fano factor of photon current in three-level lambda systems
arxiv-2201-00348.creator: Davinder Singh, Seogjoo J. Jang, Changbong Hyeon
arxiv-2201-00348.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Davinder Singh, Seogjoo J. Jang, Changbong Hyeon. Electromagnetically induced slow-light medium is a promising system for quantum memory devices, but controlling its noise level remains a major challenge to overcome. This work considers the simplest model for such medium, comprised of three-level Λ \Lambda -systems interacting with bosonic bath, and provides a new fundamental trade-off relation in light-matter interaction between the group velocity of light and the Fano factor of photon current due to radiative transitions.

arxiv-2210-07152.title: Smooth Calibration, Leaky Forecasts, Finite Recall, and Nash Dynamics Thanks: Previous versions: July 2012, February 2015, March 2017. arxiv-2210-07152.creator: Dean P. Foster, Sergiu Hart
arxiv-2210-07152.description: Abstract We propose to smooth out the calibration score, which measures how good a forecaster is, by combining nearby forecasts. While regular calibration can be guaranteed only by randomized forecasting procedures, we show that smooth calibration can be guaranteed by deterministic procedures. As a consequence, it does not matter if the forecasts are leaked , i.e.

arxiv-2301-01584.title: Generalizations of Hermitian-Einstein equation of cyclic Higgs bundles, their heat equation, and inequality estimates
arxiv-2301-01584.creator: Natsuo Miyatake
arxiv-2301-01584.description: Abstract We introduce some generalizations of the Hermitian-Einstein equation for diagonal harmonic metrics on cyclic Higgs bundles, including a generalization using subharmonic functions. When the coefficients are all smooth, we prove the existence, uniqueness, and convergence of the solution of their heat equations with Dirichlet boundary conditions.

arxiv-2302-07013.title: The fermion-boson map for large d d and its connection to lattice transformations
arxiv-2302-07013.creator: Evangelos G. Filothodoros 1
arxiv-2302-07013.description: Abstract I point out that the phase transitions of the d + 1 d+1 Gross-Neveu and C ​ P N − 1 CP^{N-1} models at finite temperature and imaginary chemical potential can be mapped to transformations of regular hexagonal and regular triangular lattices to square lattice.

arxiv-2305-14300.title: Distributed CONGEST Algorithms against Mobile Adversaries
arxiv-2305-14300.creator: Orr Fischer, Merav Parter
arxiv-2305-14300.description: Abstract In their seminal PODC 1991 paper, Ostrovsky and Yung introduced the study of distributed computation in the presence of mobile adversaries which can dynamically appear throughout the network, analogous to a spread of a virus. Over the years, this setting has been studied mostly under the assumption that the communication graph is fully-connected.

arxiv-2312-02167.title: Uncertainty Quantification in Machine Learning Based Segmentation: A Post-Hoc Approach for Left Ventricle Volume Estimation in MRI
arxiv-2312-02167.creator: Felix Terhag, Philipp Knechtges, Achim Basermann, Raúl Tempone
arxiv-2312-02167.description: Abstract Recent studies have confirmed cardiovascular diseases remain responsible for highest the death toll amongst non-communicable diseases. The accurate left ventricular (LV) volume estimation is critical for valid diagnosis and management of various cardiovascular conditions, but poses a significant challenge due to inherent uncertainties associated with the segmentation algorithms in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

arxiv-2405-20245.title: Retrieval Augmented Structured Generation: Business Document Information Extraction As Tool Use
arxiv-2405-20245.creator: Franz Louis Cesista, Rui Aguiar, Jason Kim, Paolo Acilo
arxiv-2405-20245.description: Abstract Business Document Information Extraction (BDIE) is the problem of transforming a blob of unstructured information (raw text, scanned documents, etc.) into a structured format that downstream systems can parse and use. It has two main tasks: Key-Information Extraction (KIE) and Line Items Recognition (LIR).

arxiv-2406-02413.title: Variance-Reduced Fast Krasnosel’skiǐ-Mann Methods for Finite-Sum Root-Finding Problems
arxiv-2406-02413.creator: Quoc Tran-Dinh
arxiv-2406-02413.description: Abstract We develop a new class of fast Krasnosel’skiǐ-Mann methods with variance reduction to solve a finite-sum cocoercive equation G ​ x = 0 Gx=0 . Our algorithm is single-loop and leverages a new family of unbiased variance-reduced estimators specifically designed for a wider class of root-finding algorithms.

arxiv-2411-15844.title: Unveiling the Superior Paradigm: A Comparative Study of Source-Free Domain Adaptation and Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2411-15844.creator: Fan Wang, Zhongyi Han *, Xingbo Liu, Xin Gao, Yilong Yin *
arxiv-2411-15844.description: Abstract In domain adaptation, there are two popular paradigms: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA), which aligns distributions using source data, and Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA), which leverages pre-trained source models without accessing source data. Evaluating the superiority of UDA versus SFDA is an open and timely question with significant implications for deploying adaptive algorithms in practical applications.

arxiv-2501-07566.title: SafeSwarm: Decentralized Safe RL for the Swarm of Drones Landing in Dense Crowds Thanks: Research reported in this publication was financially supported by the RSF grant No. 24-41-02039.
arxiv-2501-07566.creator: Grik Tadevosyan, Maksim Osipenko, Demetros Aschu, Aleksey Fedoseev, Valerii Serpiva, Oleg Sautenkov, Sausar Karaf, Dzmitry Tsetserukou
arxiv-2501-07566.description: Abstract This paper introduces a safe swarm of drones capable of performing landings in crowded environments robustly by relying on Reinforcement Learning techniques combined with Safe Learning. The developed system allows us to teach the swarm of drones with different dynamics to land on moving landing pads in an environment while avoiding collisions with obstacles and between agents.

arxiv-2502-15870.title: Making Sense of AI Limitations: How Individual Perceptions Shape Organizational Readiness for AI Adoption
arxiv-2502-15870.creator: Thomas Übellacker
arxiv-2502-15870.description: Abstract This study investigates how individuals’ perceptions of artificial intelligence (AI) limitations influence organizational readiness for AI adoption. Through semi-structured interviews with seven AI implementation experts, analyzed using the Gioia methodology, the research reveals that organizational readiness emerges through dynamic interactions between individual sensemaking, social learning, and formal integration processes.

arxiv-2502-20452.title: Full-sky Models of Galactic Microwave Emission and Polarization at Sub-arcminute Scales for the Python Sky Model
arxiv-2502-20452.creator: Julian Borrill, Susan E. Clark, Jacques Delabrouille, Andrei V. Frolov, Shamik Ghosh, Brandon S. Hensley, Monica D. Hicks, Nicoletta Krachmalnicoff, King Lau, Myra M. Hicks, Nicoletta Krachmalnicoff, King Lau, Myra M. Norton, Clement Pryke, Giuseppe Puglisi, Mathieu Remazeilles, Elisa Russier, Benjamin Thorne, Jian Yao, Andrea Zonca. arxiv-2504-00939.title: WikiVideo: Article Generation from Multiple Videos
arxiv-2504-00939.creator: Alexander Martin, Reno Kriz, William Walden, Kate Sanders, Hannah Recknor, Eugene Yang, Francis Ferraro, Benjamin Van Durme
arxiv-2504-00939.description: Abstract We introduce the task of grounded article generation with the goal of creating a Wikipedia-style article from multiple diverse videos about real-world events—from natural disasters to political elections—where all the information in the article is supported by video evidence.

arxiv-2601-20089.title: Aufbau Suppressed Coupled Cluster Theory for Doubly Excited States
arxiv-2601-20089.creator: Qasim Javed, Harrison Tuckman, Eric Neuscamman
arxiv-2601-20089.description: Abstract We generalize the Aufbau suppressed coupled cluster formalism into the realm of doubly excited states by deriving, implementing, and testing a wave function initialization strategy that allows the zeroth order wave function to match the largest configurations of a doubly excited reference wave function while maintaining the method’s overall asymptotic cost parity with ground state singles and doubles theory.

europmc-pmc2746531.description: In computing the probability that a woman is a BRCA1 or BRCA2 carrier for genetic counselling purposes, it is important to allow for the fact that other breast cancer susceptibility genes may exist. We used data from both a population based series of breast cancer cases and high

plos-pone-0010588.title: Rhinovirus Genome Evolution during Experimental Human Infection
plos-pone-0010588.creator: Samuel Cordey, Thomas Junier, Daniel Gerlach et al.
plos-pone-0010588.description: PLOS ONE research article. Human rhinoviruses (HRVs) evolve rapidly due in part to their error-prone RNA polymerase. Knowledge of the diversity of HRV populations emerging during the course of a natural infection is essential and represents a basis for the design of future potential vaccines and antiviral

pmc-10529657.title: The Effect of High Pressure Homogenization on the Structure of Dual-Protein and Its Emulsion Functional Properties
pmc-10529657.creator: Meishan Wu, Xiaoye He, Duo Feng, Hu Li, Di Han, Qingye Li, Boya Zhao, Na Li, Tianxin Liu, Jing Wang, Seyed-Ahmad Shahidi
pmc-10529657.description: It has been proven that high-pressure homogenization (HPH) could improve the functional properties of proteins by modifying their structure. This study researched the effect of HPH on the structural and functional properties of whey-soy dual-protein (Soy Protein Isolation-Whey Protein Isolation, SPI-WPI).

pmc-10536738.title: Effect of Octene Block Copolymer (OBC) and High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) on Crystalline Morphology, Structure and Mechanical Properties of Octene Random Copolymer
pmc-10536738.creator: Yuan-Xia Wang, Cun-Ying Zou, Nan Bai, Qun-Feng Su, Li-Xin Song, Xian-Liang Li
pmc-10536738.description: Blending octene random copolymer (ORC) with other polymers is a promising approach to improving ORC mechanical properties, such as tensile strength and elongation. In this study, octene block copolymer (OBC) with lower density than ORC and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) were used to blend with ORC.

pmc-10667067.title: Nonpharmacological home remedies for upper respiratory tract infections: a cross-sectional study of primary care patients in Switzerland and France
pmc-10667067.creator: Paul Sebo, Neria E Winkler, Mohamed Amir Moussa, Dagmar M Haller, Hubert Maisonneuve
pmc-10667067.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundMany patients might be tempted to use nonpharmacological home remedies (NPHRs) to relieve upper respiratory tract infection (URTI) symptoms. However, primary care physicians (PCPs) rarely recommend NPHRs due to a lack of knowledge in this field. We conducted a questionnaire-based survey among primary care patients in Switzerland and France to explore which NPHRs they use and consider effective for 3 common URTI symptoms: sore throat/cough/common cold.MethodsUsing official physician registries, we randomly selected 50 PCPs in Geneva (Switzerland) and Lyon/Grenoble (France).

pmc-10750668.title: Corrective Distal Tibio-Fibular Osteotomy for Medial Ankle Osteoarthritis: Consecutive 67 Cases, Prognostic Factors and 3B Cases Outcomes Evaluation
pmc-10750668.creator: Je-Min Im, Jung-Won Lim, Hong-Geun Jung
pmc-10750668.description: Category:Ankle Arthritis; AnkleIntroduction/Purpose:Supramalleolar osteotomy is a considerable technique for medial compartment ankle arthritis as a joint preservation and has been shown to be effective in several studiesThe indication for supramalleolar osteotomy is generally presented as early and mid-stage arthritis (Takakura stage 2 or 3A), and there is much arguments about the application of stage 3B.

pmc-10805836.title: Principles, developments, and applications of spatially resolved spectroscopy in agriculture: a review
pmc-10805836.creator: Yu Xia, Wenxi Liu, Jingwu Meng, Jinghao Hu, Wenbo Liu, Jie Kang, Bin Luo, Han Zhang, Wei Tang
pmc-10805836.description: Agriculture is the primary source of human survival, which provides the most basic living and survival conditions for human beings. As living standards continue to improve, people are also paying more attention to the quality and safety of agricultural products. Therefore, the detection of agricultural product quality is very necessary.

pmc-11379651.title: Molecularly matched targeted therapy: a promising approach for refractory metastatic melanoma
pmc-11379651.creator: Emily Connell, Émilie Gerard, Bénédicte Oules, Florence Brunet-Possenti, Anouck Lamoureux, Hugo Bonnefille, Sorilla Mary-Prey, Ana Carrasquilla, Stéphane Mouret, Nora Kramkimel, Candice Lesage, Pierre-Emmanuel Stoebner, Axel Bartoli, Sandrine Monestier, Florian Correard, Audrey Gros, Arnaud Jeanson,
pmc-11379651.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundOnly a fraction of patients with metastatic melanoma derive durable benefit from approved treatments. The clinical impact of personalized medicine strategies for melanoma, apart from BRAF, NRAS, or CKIT targeting, has rarely been reported.Materials and MethodsBy means of the Group of Cutaneous Oncology of the French Society of Dermatology, we retrospectively included all patients with advanced melanoma aged 18 years and older for whom molecular testing identified one or more actionable molecular alterations and who accordingly received molecularly matched therapy.

pmc-11480386.title: Lessons learned from 12 years using the Woven Endobridge for the treatment of cerebral aneurysms in a multi-center series
pmc-11480386.creator: Lukas Goertz, Thomas Liebig, Eberhard Siebert, David Zopfs, Lenhard Pennig, Muriel Pflaeging, Marc Schlamann, Alexandra Radomi, Franziska Dorn, Christoph Kabbasch
pmc-11480386.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Intrasaccular flow disruption with the Woven Endobridge (WEB) has become a well-established endovascular technique for the treatment of intracranial aneurysms. This study presents our 12-year experience with the WEB and evaluates its evolving indications, procedures, and outcomes. A consecutive series of 324 aneurysms treated with WEB between 2011 and 2023 at three neurovascular centers was retrospectively analyzed and the study group was divided into four treatment periods.

pmc-11488711.title: Taxonomy of the Palearctic socially parasitic Temnothorax (Myrmoxenus) ants (Hymenoptera: Formicidae)
pmc-11488711.creator: Ferenc Báthori, Bernhard Seifert, Jürgen Heinze, Kadri Kiran, Celal Karaman, Sándor Csősz
pmc-11488711.description: The ant genus Temnothorax is one of the most diverse in the Palearctic region, comprising several species with different life histories and uncertain taxonomic backgrounds. Socially parasitic Temnothorax ant species were typically described decades ago, primarily based on traditional morphological traits.

pmc-11538508.title: On the nature of hydrogen bonding in the H2S dimer
pmc-11538508.creator: Svenja Jäger, Jai Khatri, Philipp Meyer, Stefan Henkel, Gerhard Schwaab, Apurba Nandi, Priyanka Pandey, Kayleigh R. Barlow, Morgan A. Perkins, Gregory S. Tschumper, Joel M. Bowman, Ad van der Avoird, Martina Havenith
pmc-11538508.description: Hydrogen bonding is a central concept in chemistry and biochemistry, and so it continues to attract intense study. Here, we examine hydrogen bonding in the H2S dimer, in comparison with the well-studied water dimer, in unprecedented detail. We record a mass-selected IR spectrum of the H2S dimer in superfluid helium nanodroplets.

pmc-11599493.title: Safety and efficacy of generic nab-paclitaxel-based therapy in Chinese patients with malignant tumors in a real-world setting: a multicenter prospective observational study
pmc-11599493.creator: Fei He, Yancai Sun, Wenzhou Zhang, Qiongshi Wu, Donghang Xu, Zaixian Bai, Zhiying Hao, Weiyi Feng, Kanghuai Zhang, Jiang Liu, Mei Dong, Guangxuan Liu, Guohui Li
pmc-11599493.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of generic nab-paclitaxel in the Chinese population in a real-world setting.MethodsThis prospective, multicenter, observational study enrolled patients with malignancies who received any generic nab-paclitaxel-based regimens in China. The primary endpoint was safety, and secondary endpoint was objective response rate (ORR).

pmc-12570518.title: WGS-based surveillance for Campylobacter spp. in human infections and chicken meat production in Italy (2023)
pmc-12570518.creator: Aurora García-Fernández, Irene Artuso, Francesca Marotta, Roberta Di Romualdo, Sergio Arena, Maria Laura De Marchis, Monica Pitti, Sara Primavilla, Maira Napoleoni, Richard Aschbacher, Silvia Bracco, Matteo Gradassi, Anna Janowicz, Giuliano Garofolo, Laura Villa
pmc-12570518.description: BackgroundCampylobacter spp. infections present an urgent and significant global public health challenge. This study offers a genomic characterization of Campylobacter spp. isolates from human samples and chicken-origin food sources in Italy during 2023. Whole-genome sequencing, cluster analysis, genomic comparison of human and food of animal origin isolates, and characterization of antimicrobial resistance mechanisms were performed on 257 isolates.

pmc-12835077.title: Structural analysis and antimicrobial assessment of bioinspired silver nanoparticles from Ferula communis
pmc-12835077.creator: Yasmeen M G Alshamari, Hamad Z Alkhathlan, Ponmurugan Karuppiah, Mujeeb Khan, Ekram Y Danish, Ahmad Aqel, Syed Farooq Adil, Mohammed Rafi Shaik, Merajuddin Khan
pmc-12835077.description: The green synthesis of nanoparticles using plant extracts has garnered significant interest from scientists worldwide due to its advantages over traditional chemical processes. This method is rapid, eco-friendly, non-toxic, and cost-effective. The current study focuses on preparing silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) using Ferula communis extract as a green reducing agent.

pmc-13052149.title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Segmentation of Three Oral Diseases: Enabling Precision Diagnosis and Decision Support
pmc-13052149.creator: Baowen Cheng, Meijuan Xiang, Zhuofan Zhao, Xiaodong Zhang, Yu-feng Wang, Shuyun Ge, Fang Zhao, Meng Li, Haiyan Wang
pmc-13052149.description: IntroductionThe advancement of AI-assisted oral disease diagnosis critically relies on the availability of annotated, high-quality datasets and resilient deep learning architectures. Nevertheless, progress in this domain has been impeded by the scarcity of publicly accessible data and inadequate benchmarking of existing models.

pmc-13493036.title: Metastatic Cutaneous Apocrine Carcinoma: Diagnostic and Therapeutic Challenges in a Rare Malignancy
pmc-13493036.creator: Bryan L Chan, Chika Iguh, Andrew Hwang, Charity Huang
pmc-13493036.description: Cutaneous apocrine carcinoma is a rare adnexal malignancy with limited evidence guiding treatment in the metastatic setting. We present the case of a 50-year-old man with hormone receptor-positive metastatic cutaneous apocrine carcinoma of the right axilla initially treated with surgical excision, nodal resection, and adjuvant radiation therapy. He later developed metastatic recurrence involving the spine and lungs, requiring surgical stabilization.

pmc-13523731.title: Genotypes, Fluconazole Tolerance and Virulence Phenotypes of Candida albicans Bloodstream Isolates: A Multilocus Sequence Typing‐Based Analysis
pmc-13523731.creator: Shang‐Yi Lin, Yin‐Tse Huang, Ho‐Yin Huang, Wei‐Chun Hung, Yi‐Ting Tseng, Po‐Liang Lu
pmc-13523731.description: BackgroundFluconazole tolerance is an emerging phenotype in Candida albicans bloodstream infections, but its relationship to multilocus sequence typing (MLST) lineages and virulence traits is unclear.ObjectivesTo investigate the relationships among MLST genotypes, fluconazole tolerance, and virulence phenotypes in C. albicans bloodstream isolates.Methods179 C. albicans bloodstream isolates collected from three hospitals in southern Taiwan (2013–2020) were evaluated.

pmc-13556469.title: 468. Examining the prevalence, clinical characteristics and outcomes of patients with tardive dyskinesia (TD) through analysis of UK Electronic Health Record (EHR) data
pmc-13556469.creator: A R Hodgson, L Matthews, J R Lewis, R N Cardinal, R Krishnadas, R Patel
pmc-13556469.description: BackgroundTD is a movement disorder caused by exposure to dopamine receptor antagonists such as antipsychotics. TD is estimated to affect 20-30% of antipsychotic-treated patients, but is underdiagnosed. Unstructured EHR data, such as text notes recorded by clinicians, can allow for identification of patients lacking a formal diagnosis.

pmc-13567995.title: XAI-Driven Intrusion Detection for Internet of Things Networks
pmc-13567995.creator: Awatif Alqahtani, Fatimah Alakeel, Lujain Abuhaimed
pmc-13567995.description: Systems that can reliably detect intrusion are increasingly in demand as the scale and heterogeneity of Internet of Things (IoT) networks rise. However, when strong tabular models are employed as a benchmark, it is not clear whether the complexity of ensembling actually pays off.
